title: RhymeQ Emerges from Stealth with $2.2 Million Pre-Seed Round to Launch Python Abstraction Layer for Quantum Computing
excerpt: Quantum software startup RhymeQ secured $2.2 million in pre-seed funding to develop Rhyme, a high-level quantum programming platform. Rhyme allows developers to program quantum software using Python, abstracting away low-level quantum circuit details. The platform compiles to NVIDIA CUDA-Q, enabling execution across various quantum hardware and simulators.
content:
Karlsruhe and Zürich-based quantum software startup RhymeQ has emerged from stealth with $2.2 million USD in pre-seed financing to develop its high-level quantum programming platform, Rhyme.

The funding round was led by deep-tech investor Ground State Ventures, with participation from Vanagon Ventures, Plug and Play, and Freiraum Ventures. RhymeQ develops an abstraction layer designed to allow developers with standard Python proficiency to program and debug quantum software without requiring low-level quantum circuit compilation or gate-level hardware expertise.

Unveiled during NVIDIA GTC Berlin, Rhyme compiles directly to the NVIDIA CUDA-Q framework, enabling code execution across GPU-accelerated quantum simulators and multiple physical quantum processor architectures without hardware lock-in. The capital will be deployed to expand the company’s engineering team, accelerate enterprise platform integration, and grow its developer waitlist community.
